title: VerifiedEntry newtype enforces signature verification at type level
description: group_log/verify.rs VerifiedEntry is a newtype that can only be constructed via verify_signature() or the cfg(test)-gated new_for_test(). This makes it impossible to pass an unverified LogEntry where a VerifiedEntry is required without going through the verification path. Correct use of Rust's type system for security invariants — no runtime checks needed at call sites.
